notes: Q1'22-Q4'23 come from the 6-K earnings releases (Shopify filed 40-F/6-K then); Q1'24 onward from 10-Q/10-K XBRL. Shopify became a US domestic filer (10-K) for FY2024. Revenue includes the logistics businesses until their sale in mid-2023 (Deliverr), which depresses H2'23-H1'24 YoY comparisons. Revenue model is transactional (judgment call): merchant solutions (payments/GMV-linked) were 2,781 of 3,583 = 77.6% of Q2'26 revenue; subscription solutions were 22.4% (MRR $221M). Guidance is qualitative only: Q3'26 revenue to grow at a 'low-thirties percentage rate' YoY. 3,740 = Q3'25 2,844 x 1.315, an assumed ~31.5% midpoint (derived, not a company figure). Gross margin is GAAP (Shopify no longer reports non-GAAP margins); there is no adjusted operating margin, so the scorer uses GAAP 13.6%. TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): OCF 2,377, capex 25, FCF 2,352 on revenue 13,269. Net cash = cash 1,656 + marketable securities 3,291 + long-term investments 525 at 6/30/26. It excludes equity and other investments (4,854, mostly listed stakes) and the equity-method investment (559). The convertible notes matured in Nov 2025, so there is no debt; operating leases excluded. ttm_pe/eps_growth (judgment call): Shopify reports no adjusted EPS. It does report non-GAAP 'net income excluding the impact of equity investments': TTM 367+594+360+439=1,760 vs prior 344+458+226+338=1,366. P/E = market cap / that figure; growth is on net income, since the diluted share count is roughly flat at ~1.30B. GAAP TTM EPS $1.48 (P/E ~102) swings with mark-to-market gains. Price $151.39 at the 2026-10-02 close.
